test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The amount on a sum of ₹6,500 at 20% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹6,500

Rate (r) = 20% per annum

Time (t) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)t

**Calculations:**

A = ₹6,500(1 + 20/100)²

⇒ A = ₹6,500(1 + 0.2)²

⇒ A = ₹6,500(1.2)²

⇒ A = ₹6,500 × 1.44

⇒ A = ₹9,360

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
